intent.problem_statement: Implementation des Frontend UIs für Modul 2: SSOT Master-Profile Editor und Magic Sync Command Center (ohne Stripe/Pay-Later für reduzierte Komplexität).

constraints.performance_requirements: Flüssiges Ausfüllen, Instant Feedback beim Senden

logic_flows: Nav to /dashboard/profile -> Click 'Sync' -> router.push('/dashboard/sync-center') -> Cinematic Sync Mock -> router.push('/dashboard')
architecture.state_management: Next.js App Router for navigation context

decisions.resolution: Option A (Single-Page Control Panel). A unified, efficient form highlighting 'Red Flags' directly inline. Chosen for its 'Premium Utility' vibe.

decisions.issue: Routing Architecture for SSOT and Command Center
decisions.resolution: Option B (Isolierte Routes). Dedicated /dashboard/profile and /dashboard/sync-center routes for clean encapsulation of GSAP animations and modular state.

Option A (Frontend Theatre). Use a React useEffect loop to simulate progress and animate GSAP for speed. Future-proofing: The sync logic will be wrapped in a custom hook (e.g. `useMagicSync`) so it can be cleanly swapped for real API polling (Google/Apple) in the future.
